subject: Vendor onboarding: PO acknowledgement mode & flexible net-term ladder
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@fluxware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO acknowledgement mode & flexible net-term ladder

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for taking our call earlier. We’re starting the Redwood onboarding process on our side and I have a couple of quick questions before we submit the vendor packet: 

- PO vs standalone invoice: does Redwood require a Purchase Order number on every invoice, or is there a supported standalone-invoice flow for recurring services while we finalize PO setups? If standalone is accepted, is there a preferred invoice header and remit-to format?
- Net terms / early pay: FluxWare’s standard is Net60, but we’d like to explore whether we can enroll in an early-pay ladder (tiered discount for accelerated settlement). What are Redwood’s common incentive tiers and operational requirements to opt in?

I’ve attached our completed onboarding form for the fields we already have (FluxWare_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf). If you can confirm the PO/standalone policy and the typical early-pay options, we’ll fill the remaining bank/W9 details and return.

Appreciate it — Ellen

Ellen Park
Head of Finance, FluxWare
ellen.park@fluxware.com | +1 415-555-0182
Attachment: FluxWare_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@fluxware.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO acknowledgement mode & flexible net-term ladder

Hi Ellen —

Great to hear you’re moving forward. Quick answers and next steps below. I’ve also attached a short spreadsheet with the EarlyPay tiers we typically offer (EarlyPay_Incentive_Tiers.xlsx).

PO vs standalone invoice:
- Hosted production work: we prefer PO-backed invoices for any subscription or committed spend (PO number included on the invoice header).
- Standalone invoices: we can accept standalone invoices for one-off professional services or pilot work, but these require an AP note on the invoice and manual routing which slows payment cycles. If you intend to rely on standalone invoices long term, we’ll need to align on invoice headers and a remit email.

Early-pay options (summary):
- Standard: Net60 (default)
- Early-pay ladder (opt-in):
  * Tier A: 2.0% discount if paid within 15 days
  * Tier B: 1.25% discount if paid within 30 days
  * Tier C: 0.75% discount if paid within 45 days
Enrollment requirements:
- Completed onboarding form + W-9
- ACH details + bank verification (sandbox of micro-deposits ok)
- Explicit opt-in confirmation on the onboarding form and a signed finance addendum (DocuSign link below once we have the bank/W-9)
- PO header mapping for invoice routing (PO number + bill-to/project code)

Operational notes:
- If you opt into the ladder, Redwood Finance will prioritize those invoices in the earliest run that satisfies the discount window. Cutoff for early-pay runs is 10:00 AM PT on payment day; invoices must be validated and in the AP queue by then.
- For PO-based flows we can set automatic PO-acknowledgement (DocuSign) — this makes the acknowledgement part of the legal/acceptance record and speeds routing.

Next steps from FluxWare:
1) Update the onboarding form with W-9 and ACH (you can redact the account number when sharing initially, then we'll do micro-deposit verification).
2) Indicate which EarlyPay tier you want to enroll in.
3) Tell us whether you’ll be submitting invoices against a PO or via standalone invoices for the first 90 days.

I’ve looped in Monica (vendor ops) to handle the onboarding checklist and David for the final finance approval on the tier. Ben is on the thread for any contract/PO-ack questions.

I’ll send the DocuSign addendum once you confirm the tier.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: EarlyPay_Incentive_Tiers.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@fluxware.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO acknowledgement mode & flexible net-term ladder

Ellen / team —

Quick finance note from our side to set expectations before you sign up for a tier:
- We can approve early-pay discounts up to 2.0% for accelerated settlement under agreed operational controls. Typical approvals we grant to new vendors are: 1.75% for Net30 enrollment or 1.0% for Net45, depending on volume and PO assurance. The 2.0% Tier A Marissa mentioned is grantable in narrow cases (high volume, long-term commitment).
- Net60 is the default for new vendors not enrolled in early-pay. Enrollment is evaluated monthly; we’ll require a 60-day monitoring window before moving to a permanent pricing/discount status.

Must-have docs to enable early-pay runs:
- Completed onboarding form (we need the W-9)
- ACH + micro-deposit verification (or bank letter on company letterhead)
- Copy of your PO-ack process if you’re sending PO-based invoices (we need to map PO header fields to our AP system)
- Vendor contact for payment questions (email + phone)

Operational constraints:
- Invoices must be syntactically valid and routed to apinvoices@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject to be considered for early-pay runs. Invoices received after 10:00 AM PT on scheduled payment days will be queued for the next run and may miss the discount window.
- For standalone invoices, we require a short justification field on the invoice (pilot, one-time consulting, etc.) and manual approval which can add 7–10 days.

If FluxWare confirms a preferred tier, we’ll provision the DocuSign addendum and share the PO-ack template. Happy to set a 30-minute call with AP operations to walk through the PO header mapping if that’s helpful.

-David Kim
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@fluxware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO acknowledgement mode & flexible net-term ladder

Marissa / David / team —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. FluxWare will enroll in the early-pay ladder but we’d like to start at a conservative compromise: 1.5% discount for invoices paid within 30 days (Net30 with a 1.5% accelerated-settlement discount). That aligns with our cash needs while remaining operationally simple.

Actions completed (attached):
- Signed onboarding form (Signed_Onboarding_Form_FluxWare.pdf) — includes W-9 and preliminary ACH routing (we’ve redacted the account number; we’ll complete micro-deposits once you confirm).
- We opted to submit invoices against PO numbers where possible for subscription fees; for initial professional services invoices we may use standalone invoices and will add the justification field.

Please send the DocuSign addendum and PO-ack template and we’ll sign/return. Also welcome the 30-minute run-through call for PO header mapping — I’m available tomorrow afternoon PT.

Ellen Park
Head of Finance, FluxWare
ellen.park@fluxware.com
Attachment: Signed_Onboarding_Form_FluxWare.pdf (application/pdf)
